name: moai-lane-watchdog
description: > One lane stall watchdog iteration: measure lane progress on three channels, classify the stall cause, apply the remedy or resolve the judgment through the decision ladder — instead of waiting on a reply — then record the outcome and report. Reads the unified --auto doctrine at .claude/rules/moai/workflow/auto-semantics.md for the ladder, the gate inventory, and the record formats.
